html.attributeNameCase: parse5 HTML names; ASCII-lower only for enum matching
html.template: walk childNodes and content DocumentFragment conservatively
html.script: only type=application/json and no src; all other script or parsed attribute name starting ASCII on => active-script
html.meta: charset only utf-8; name/content inert; http-equiv refresh => navigation before generic attribute refusal; all other http-equiv => unsupported-reference-syntax
html.link: rel exactly stylesheet (ASCII-case-insensitive); one declared local text/css href; no other rel/tokens
html.anchors: retain href bytes; never follow or treat as automatic resource; no img discovery from href

atRules.font-face: only font-family and src; every src URL is declared font resource
atRules.import: exactly one maintained AST String or Url prelude, no qualifiers/block; traverse local stylesheet graph
atRules.media: maintained parsed prelude; walk all child rules independent of condition
atRules.supports: maintained parsed prelude; walk prelude URL nodes conservatively as image edges and all child rules

functions.format: font-face src only; String argument truetype only

css.url: maintained Url node only; decoded value once; escaped semantic url remaining Function => unsupported-reference-syntax
css.identifierNormalization: maintained ident.decode then ASCII-lower for policy names
css.stringNormalization: maintained parsed String.value only; no second unescape
css.propertyGrammar: maintained lexer.matchProperty for ordinary declarations; lexer.matchAtruleDescriptor for font-face; error/no matched tree => unsupported-reference-syntax
css.sourceLocals: local() not allowed; system fallback font shorthand unchanged
css.selectors: maintained SelectorList/Selector AST; no selector evaluation or paint classification; parse error/Raw => refuse; no URL grammar in selector strings
css.escapedFunctionPolicy: Decoded Function name outside finite function table (including semantic url) refuses. Url token/node payload escapes are supported; no custom escaped-function parser.
css.rawGrammarPhase: Recognized active markers scan after syntax parse but before generic rule/grammar refusal; parser errors/Raw are deferred until this scan completes.
css.atRulePreludeGrammar: Use lexer.matchAtrulePrelude for media/supports. Plain import must be exactly one String/Url node; font-face has null prelude. Any unmatched/extra node refuses.
css.safeSourceEncoding: UTF-8 only; no @charset allowed; any other CSS encoding or unknown HTML charset refuses source-encoding. Original bytes unchanged.

dataUrls.bodyBinding: origin page/CSS SHA+AST offset+parsed MIME essence+decoded byte SHA; exact source unchanged

accounting.bundle: main bytes once + all declared asset bytes once + each distinct inline(MIME,bodySHA) decoded body once
accounting.resources: all declared asset identities + new distinct inline(MIME,bodySHA) identities; duplicate reference edges do not add resources
accounting.edges: each source URL occurrence, including repeated and font/css/image edges;64 maximum
accounting.ast: Count every maintained HTML and CSS AST node, including empty StyleSheet and DeclarationList roots. Document root depth0; each AST child +1, each separately parsed CSS root depth0. HTML comments/text/template fragments count; CSS comments count only when represented by maintained AST. Empty style in the node-budget fixtures adds one CSS StyleSheet root to seven HTML nodes. Combined node ceiling100000 inclusive; per-tree depth ceiling256 inclusive.
accounting.importDepth: entry HTML-linked/inline stylesheet depth0; each import adds1;8 accepted,9 refused
accounting.visited: local path+role+frozenSHA; stack cycle refuses, repeated noncycle reuse allowed with edge counted
accounting.unused: declared assets charged and hash-checked even unused

tieBreak: within phase main/proof order, node source offset, local imported DFS order; first fixed failure; cleanup failure supersedes with primaryReason retained

sourceResult.sourceEligible: source only; NOT final eligible/native or reader pass

newBoundaryReasons.budget: main-byte-limit / asset-byte-limit / aggregate-byte-limit / resource-count-limit as exact failing bound
newBoundaryReasons.cleanup: cleanup-failed; unknown closure never claimed closed

sourceWorker.scope: one dedicated source-parser child per delivery bundle, not browser/header/process-general runner
sourceWorker.input: bounded frozen raw bundle buffers only; all identity/declared limits checked first; no user paths/URLs for child filesystem/network
sourceWorker.success: actual terminal exit0+complete bounded validated graph record before metadata/header owners
sourceWorker.failure: never settle/late result/error/overflow => source-preflight-unavailable; kill and confirm reap; unconfirmed exit=>cleanup-failed; no later owner
sourceWorker.receipts: typed enums/counts/hashes only; raw AST/source/EXIF not logged
sourceWorker.nonUIInventory: port,rust-27; future dedicated source adapter and tests need canonical inventory before integration
